Record Class CrdbStats

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.cockroachlabs.crdb.observe.CrdbStats
Record Components:
retryAttempts - total retryable anomalies retried
retriesExhausted - total operations that exhausted their retries
circuitOpens - total circuit-breaker OPEN transitions
public record CrdbStats(long retryAttempts, long retriesExhausted, long circuitOpens) extends Record
A snapshot of process-wide operational counters.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. All components in this record class are compared with the compare method from their corresponding wrapper classes.
